package user;

import org.openqa.selenium.By;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebElement;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.support.ui.Select;

public class UserData {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
       //System.setProperty("webdriver.chrome.driver", "C:\\Users\\User\\Downloads\\chromedriver-win64\\chromedriver-win64\\chromedriver.exe");
       
       WebDriver driver = new ChromeDriver();
       
       try {
    	   driver.get("file:///C:/Users/User/Downloads/Home.html");
    	   driver.manage().window().maximize();
    	   
    	   WebElement fulname = driver.findElement(By.id("name"));
    	   fulname.sendKeys("kamal");
    	   
    	   WebElement email = driver.findElement(By.name("email"));
    	   email.sendKeys("kamal@gmail.com");
    	   
    	   WebElement password = driver.findElement(By.xpath("//*[@id=\"password\"]"));
    	   password.sendKeys("kamal@123");
    	   
    	   WebElement gender = driver.findElement(By.id("male"));
    	   gender.click();
    	   
    	   Select country = new Select(driver.findElement(By.id("country")));
    	   country.selectByVisibleText("India");
    	   
    	   Thread.sleep(3000);
       }catch(Exception e) {
    	   e.printStackTrace();
       }
       
      
	}

}






20-21   Q2


package Hello;

import org.openqa.selenium.Alert;
import org.openqa.selenium.By;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebElement;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.support.ui.Select;

public class User {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
        OpenBrowser();
        loginAdmin();
        UrlValidation();
        dropDown();
        search();
        newUser();
        logout();
	}
	
	public static WebDriver driver;
	
	public static void OpenBrowser() {
		System.setProperty("webdriver.chrome.driver", "F:\\selinium\\chromedriver.exe");
		
		driver = new ChromeDriver();
		
		driver.get("http://localhost/employee/admin/");
		driver.manage().window().maximize();
		
		
	}
	
	public static void loginAdmin() {
		String username = "admin@gmail.com";
		String password = "admin@12345";
		
	
		WebElement usename1 = driver.findElement(By.name("username"));
		usename1.sendKeys(username);
		
		WebElement pass = driver.findElement(By.name("password"));
		pass.sendKeys(password);
		
		if(username.isEmpty()) {
			System.out.println("username is empty");
		}
		if(password.isEmpty()) {
			System.out.println("password is empty");
		}
		
		WebElement login = driver.findElement(By.xpath("//*[@id=\"login-frm\"]/button[1]"));
		login.click();
		
		try {
			Thread.sleep(2000);
		}catch(Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		}
		
		
				
	}

	public static void UrlValidation() {
		WebElement employee = driver.findElement(By.id("Employee"));
		employee.click();
		
		try {
			Thread.sleep(2000);
		}catch(Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		}
		
		String expentedUrl = "http://localhost/employee/admin/employee.php";
		String currentUrl = driver.getCurrentUrl();
		
		if(currentUrl.equals(expentedUrl)) {
			System.out.println("Url validation success");
		}else {
			System.out.println("Url validation failed");
		}
	}
	
	public static void dropDown() {
		Select drop = new Select(driver.findElement(By.xpath("//*[@id=\"table_length\"]/label/select")));
		drop.selectByIndex(1);
		
		String A = drop.getFirstSelectedOption().getText();
		System.out.println("The select option is :" + A);
	}
	
	public static void search() {
		String name = "Bob";
		WebElement searchitem = driver.findElement(By.xpath("//*[@id=\"table_filter\"]/label/input"));
		searchitem.sendKeys(name);
		
		System.out.println("search item is  :" + name);
	}
	
	public static void newUser() {
		WebElement newuser = driver.findElement(By.id("new_emp_btn"));
		newuser.click();
		
		try {
			Thread.sleep(1000);
		}catch(Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		}
		
		WebElement firstname = driver.findElement(By.name("firstname"));
		firstname.sendKeys("kamal");
		
		WebElement middlename = driver.findElement(By.name("middlename"));
		middlename.sendKeys("samn");
		
		WebElement lastname = driver.findElement(By.name("lastname"));
		lastname.sendKeys("perera");
		
		WebElement department = driver.findElement(By.name("department"));
		department.sendKeys("IT");
		
		WebElement position = driver.findElement(By.name("position"));
		position.sendKeys("Software Enginner");
		
		WebElement Add = driver.findElement(By.name("save"));
		Add.click();
		
		try {
			Thread.sleep(1000);
		}catch(Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		}
		
		try {
			Alert alert = driver.switchTo().alert();
			
			String alertmessage = alert.getText();
			
			System.out.println("User saving alert massage is :" + alertmessage);
			alert.accept();
			
			
		}catch(Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		}
		
		try {
			Thread.sleep(1000);
		}catch(Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		}
		
	}
	
	public static void logout() {
		WebElement logout = driver.findElement(By.xpath("/html/body/nav/div/div[2]/a"));
		logout.click();
		
	
		
	}
}











testNG q1

package Test;

import org.testng.annotations.Test;

public class DependentClass {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub

	}
	
	@Test
	public void registerAccount() {
		System.out.println("First register your account");
	}
	
	@Test(dependsOnMethods= {"registerAccount"})
	public void login() {
		System.out.println("Login to the accout after registration");
	}
	
	@Test()
	public void homePage() {
		System.out.println("This is home page");
	}
	
	@Test()
	public void sendEmail() {
		System.out.println("send email after login");
	}
	
	@Test(dependsOnMethods= {"login","homePage"})
	public void logout() {
		System.out.println("Logout current session");
	}

}






testNG q2

package Test;

import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeDriver;
import org.testng.annotations.Test;

public class SecondTestNG {
	
	@Test
	public void login() {
		System.out.println("Login to the accout after registration 2 parallel");
	}

	@Test
	public void Hello() {
		System.out.println("Hello how are you 2");
	}

	
	@Test(invocationCount= 3,threadPoolSize=3)
	public void openGoogleTest() {
		System.setProperty("webdriver.chrome.driver", "F:\\selinium\\chromedriver.exe");
		
		WebDriver driver = new ChromeDriver();
		driver.get("https://www.google.com");
		System.out.println("Google page is open");
	}

}

testNG q4


package Test;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.List;

import org.openqa.selenium.By;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebElement;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeDriver;
import org.testng.annotations.AfterTest;
import org.testng.annotations.BeforeTest;
import org.testng.annotations.Test;

public class User_Demo_Test {

	
public static WebDriver driver;
    
    // 1. Load users.php page.
    @BeforeTest
    public void setup() {
        driver = new ChromeDriver();
        driver.manage().window().maximize();
        driver.manage().timeouts().implicitlyWait(Duration.ofSeconds(10));
        
      
        driver.get("http://localhost/employee_system/users.php");
    }

  
    @Test(priority = 1)
    public void loginTest() {
        String inputUsername = "admin";
        String inputPassword = "admin123";

        WebElement usernameField = driver.findElement(By.id("username")); // හෝ By.name("username")
        WebElement passwordField = driver.findElement(By.id("password"));
        WebElement loginBtn = driver.findElement(By.id("login_btn"));

        usernameField.sendKeys(inputUsername);
        passwordField.sendKeys(inputPassword);
        loginBtn.click();

      
        try {
       
            WebElement errorMessage = driver.findElement(By.id("error_msg_id"));
            if (errorMessage.isDisplayed()) {
                System.out.println("Login Failed: " + errorMessage.getText());
            }
        } catch (Exception e) {
          
            System.out.println("Login step executed.");
        }
    }

  
    @Test(priority = 2, dependsOnMethods = {"loginTest"})
    public void searchEmployeeTest() {
        WebElement searchField = driver.findElement(By.id("search_input"));
        searchField.clear();
        searchField.sendKeys("ab");

       
        List<WebElement> rows = driver.findElements(By.cssSelector("table tbody tr"));

      
        if (rows.size() > 0 && !rows.get(0).getText().contains("No records found")) {
            System.out.println("data detected");
        } else {
            System.out.println("data undetected");
        }
    }

  
    @Test(priority = 3, dependsOnMethods = {"searchEmployeeTest"})
    public void updateAndClosePopupTest() {
       
        driver.findElement(By.id("update_user_btn")).click();
        
        
        driver.findElement(By.id("close_edit_popup")).click();
        System.out.println("Update user popup handled and closed.");
    }

  
    @Test(priority = 4, dependsOnMethods = {"loginTest"})
    public void addNewAndClosePopupTest() {
      
        driver.findElement(By.id("add_new_btn")).click();
        
       
        driver.findElement(By.id("close_add_popup")).click();
        System.out.println("Add new user popup handled and closed.");
    }

    
    @Test(priority = 5, dependsOnMethods = {"loginTest"})
    public void logoutTest() {
        WebElement logoutBtn = driver.findElement(By.id("logout_btn"));
        logoutBtn.click();
        System.out.println("Successfully logged out from the system.");
    }

    
    @AfterTest
    public void tearDown() {
        if (driver != null) {
            driver.quit();
        }
    }

}








CA 1


package QA;

import java.time.Duration;

import org.openqa.selenium.By;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebElement;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.interactions.Actions;
import org.openqa.selenium.support.ui.Select;
import org.openqa.selenium.support.ui.WebDriverWait; 
import org.openqa.selenium.support.ui.ExpectedConditions;
public class CA01 {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
        System.setProperty("webdriver.chrome.driver", "F:\\selinium\\chromedriver.exe");
        
        WebDriver driver = new ChromeDriver();
        WebDriverWait wait = new WebDriverWait(driver, Duration.ofSeconds(10));
        try {
        	driver.get("file:///D:/3.2/sqa/Ca1.html");
        	driver.manage().window().maximize();
        	
        	WebElement fulname = driver.findElement(By.id("name"));
        	fulname.sendKeys("Test User");
        	
        	WebElement Email = driver.findElement(By.id("email"));
        	Email.sendKeys("test@gmal.com");
        	
        	WebElement password = driver.findElement(By.id("password"));
        	password.sendKeys("Test@123");
        	
        	WebElement MobileNumber = driver.findElement(By.id("mobile"));
        	MobileNumber.sendKeys("0765643212");
        	
        	WebElement gender = driver.findElement(By.name("gender"));
        	gender.click();
        	
        	WebElement Hobby1 = driver.findElement(By.xpath("//*[@id=\"regForm\"]/input[7]"));
        	Hobby1.click();
        	
        	WebElement Hobby2 = driver.findElement(By.xpath("//*[@id=\"regForm\"]/input[8]"));
        	Hobby2.click();
        	
        	Select country = new Select(driver.findElement(By.name("country")));
        	country.selectByVisibleText("Sri Lanka");
        	
        	WebElement slider = driver.findElement(By.name("exp"));
            Actions move = new Actions(driver);
            move.dragAndDropBy(slider, 50, 0).perform();
            
            WebElement dob = driver.findElement(By.name("dob"));
        	dob.sendKeys("01-01-2001");
        	
        	WebElement submit = driver.findElement(By.id("submitBtn"));
        	submit.click();
        	
        	driver.findElement(By.name("firstname")).clear();
            driver.findElement(By.id("submitBtn")).click();
            
            String validationMsg = wait.until(ExpectedConditions.visibilityOfElementLocated(By.id("validationMessage"))).getText();
            System.out.println("Captured Validation Message: " + validationMsg);
        	
        	
        }catch(Exception e) {
        	e.printStackTrace();
        }
	}

}







20-21 q1

package user;

import org.openqa.selenium.By;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.WebElement;
import org.openqa.selenium.WindowType;
import org.openqa.selenium.chrome.ChromeDriver;
import org.openqa.selenium.support.ui.Select;

public class User_Registration {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		System.setProperty("webdricer.chrome.driver", "F:\\selinium\\chromedriver.exe");
		
		WebDriver driver = new ChromeDriver();
		
		try {
			driver.get("file:///D:/3.2/sqa/20_21practicalPaper/Home.html");
			driver.manage().window().maximize();
			
		 WebElement firstname = driver.findElement(By.id("firstname"));
		 firstname.sendKeys("Ravi");
		 
		 WebElement lastname = driver.findElement(By.id("lastname"));
		 lastname.sendKeys("Kathir");
		 
		 WebElement email = driver.findElement(By.id("email"));
		 email.sendKeys("Ravi@gmail.com");
		 
		 WebElement password = driver.findElement(By.id("password"));
		 password.sendKeys("ravi@12345");
		 
		 WebElement cpassword = driver.findElement(By.id("confirmPassword"));
		 cpassword.sendKeys("ravi@12345");
		 
		 String passwordText = password.getAttribute("value");
		 String ConfrimPassword = cpassword.getAttribute("value");
		 
		 if(passwordText.isEmpty()) {
			 System.out.println("password feild is empty");
		 }if(ConfrimPassword.isEmpty()) {
			 System.out.println("Confrime password feild is empty");
		 }
		 if(passwordText.equals(ConfrimPassword)) {
			 System.out.println("password are equal");
		 }else {
			 System.out.println("password are not equal");
		 }
		 
		 WebElement genderMale = driver.findElement(By.xpath("//*[@id=\"genderMale\"]"));
		 genderMale.click();
		 
		 WebElement hobby = driver.findElement(By.id("hobbyTravel"));
		 hobby.click();
		 
		 Select income = new Select(driver.findElement(By.id("sourceOfIncome")));
		 income.selectByVisibleText("Self-employed");
		 
		 Select age = new Select(driver.findElement(By.id("age")));
		 age.selectByVisibleText("30");
		 
		 WebElement biodata = driver.findElement(By.id("biodata"));
		 biodata.sendKeys("A dedicated and enthusiastic university graduate with a background in Computer Science and industry experience");
		 
		 Thread.sleep(3000);
		 
		 driver.switchTo().newWindow(WindowType.TAB);
         driver.get("https://www.google.com/");
		}catch(Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		}

	}

}
